Vengeful Merregon are a type of Fiend in Baldur's Gate 3. Merregon are footsoldiers who serve in the Nine Hells. Vengeful Merregons can be encountered in the House of Hope.

Involvement

Vengeful Merregons can be encountered after raising the alarm in the House of Hope. Raphael's Eternal Debtors can turn into Vengeful Merregons upon death or when using  Forever Indebted, though they may turn into Vengeful Boars or Vengeful Imps instead.

Combat

One of the Vengeful Merregon's most dangerous abilities is their  Flames of Avernus which applies ⁠Fire vulnerability with their attacks. Most of the other enemies fought alongside Vengeful Merregons can deal substantial fire damage which is doubled by this effect.
